callback-list.name: Callback List
callback-list.description: List open callbacks from tickets they coded as return or complaint.

crew-day.name: Crew Day
crew-day.description: Build a day list from their roster and tickets: crew, property, service, window, dog and skip flags.

enhancement-ticket.name: Enhancement Ticket
enhancement-ticket.description: Assemble one-time work from the enhancement ticket, price file, and sold proposal if present.

estimate-from-price.name: Estimate From Price
estimate-from-price.description: Draft estimate lines from their price file and the proposal or takeoff they stored.

material-pull.name: Material Pull
material-pull.description: Build a pull list from sold tickets and their material sheet.

photo-pack.name: Photo Pack
photo-pack.description: Index photos they stored to ticket and property.

route-pack.name: Route Pack
route-pack.description: Pull the route CSV and match each stop to a ticket.

seasonal-calendar.name: Seasonal Calendar
seasonal-calendar.description: List upcoming seasonal extras from their calendar and match properties that already have tickets.

weather-postpone-list.name: Weather Postpone List
weather-postpone-list.description: After they write a weather call, list postponed route stops and whether their note says next cycle or make-up.
